description: Follow a cause chain beneath a symptom while testing each link rather than assuming five repetitions prove causality
best_for: Problems with a plausible linear cause chain
facilitation_prompts: Why did this happen?|What evidence supports that link?|What enabled that cause?|Where might the chain branch?|What would disprove the proposed root cause?
output_pattern: symptom -> evidenced cause chain -> root-cause hypothesis -> test

description: Map plausible causes across people process materials equipment environment measurement and context before prioritising evidence
best_for: Multi-factor operational problems where causes may sit in several domains
facilitation_prompts: What people factors contribute?|What process conditions?|What tools materials or information?|What environmental factors?|How is the problem measured?|Which branches have evidence?
output_pattern: effect -> cause families -> candidate causes -> evidence priorities

description: Convert a vague complaint into an observable gap with scope impact and a decision to enable
best_for: Ambiguous problem statements or solution-first requests
facilitation_prompts: What exactly is happening?|What should happen instead?|Who is affected and how?|When and where?|What decision must this enable?
output_pattern: complaint -> observable gap -> bounded problem statement

description: Contrast where when who and what exhibits the problem with closely comparable cases that do not
best_for: Intermittent or unevenly distributed problems
facilitation_prompts: Where does it occur and not occur?|When does it happen and not happen?|Who is affected and not affected?|What is different between the paired cases?|What pattern does that suggest?
output_pattern: is/is-not contrasts -> distinctions -> causal clues

description: Map actors stocks flows feedback loops delays incentives and leverage points
best_for: Problems with recurrence feedback or unintended consequences
facilitation_prompts: What are the system elements?|How do they influence one another?|What reinforces or balances behaviour?|Where are the delays?|Where could a small change have leverage?
output_pattern: system map -> dynamics -> leverage points -> tests

description: Compare forces supporting a desired change with forces restraining it and choose where intervention is realistic
best_for: Adoption resistance stakeholder friction or stalled change
facilitation_prompts: What drives movement toward the goal?|What restrains it?|Which forces are strongest?|Which can be reduced or strengthened?|Who controls them?
output_pattern: driving forces vs restraining forces -> influence points -> change strategy

description: Rank measured causes by frequency cost or impact and inspect cumulative contribution
best_for: Problems with enough comparable data to identify a vital few
facilitation_prompts: What causes are recorded?|Which impact measure matters?|How reliable and comparable is the data?|What is the cumulative contribution?|Would the ranking change under another measure?
output_pattern: cause data -> ranked contribution -> vital few -> focus

description: Compare current and desired states across relevant dimensions and prioritise the gaps that block the outcome
best_for: Planning improvement across several capabilities or performance dimensions
facilitation_prompts: What is true now?|What must be true?|What gaps exist?|Which gaps are causal or merely correlated?|Which gap blocks the others?
output_pattern: current vs desired -> gaps -> dependencies -> priorities

description: Find the bottleneck limiting system throughput and distinguish it from local inefficiency
best_for: Capacity flow queue or delivery problems
facilitation_prompts: What limits total throughput?|Where does work accumulate?|What happens if this constraint is relieved?|Are we optimising a non-constraint?|What becomes the next constraint?
output_pattern: system goal -> constraint -> exploit/elevate options -> next constraint

description: Identify how a process or proposed intervention could fail and prioritise prevention detection and response
best_for: Reliability-sensitive processes and implementation planning
facilitation_prompts: What can fail?|What causes it?|What is the effect?|How likely and detectable is it?|What prevention detection or response is proportionate?
output_pattern: components -> failure modes -> effects -> controls

description: Frame what must improve and what may worsen then use inventive principles to escape the apparent trade-off
best_for: Technical or operational contradictions where ordinary compromise is unsatisfying
facilitation_prompts: What must improve?|What worsens when it does?|Is the contradiction physical technical or assumed?|Which separation or inventive principles suggest alternatives?|How do they translate here?
output_pattern: contradiction -> inventive principles -> adapted concepts

description: Use provocations reversals and random entry to break dominant patterns
best_for: Stuck solution spaces dominated by familiar answers
facilitation_prompts: What assumption can we provoke?|What if the opposite were required?|What random stimulus changes the frame?|What idea seems impossible but contains a useful principle?
output_pattern: dominant pattern -> provocation -> novel directions -> usable principles

description: List independent solution dimensions and combine alternatives systematically
best_for: Problems whose solution can vary across several design parameters
facilitation_prompts: What are the independent parameters?|What options exist for each?|Which combinations are coherent?|Which combinations have not been considered?|What constraints eliminate combinations?
output_pattern: parameters x options -> combinations -> candidate configurations

description: Look for analogous functions in living systems and translate principles rather than copying forms
best_for: Engineering service or resilience challenges with a meaningful natural analogy
facilitation_prompts: How does nature perform this function?|At what scale and under what constraints?|What principle transfers?|Where does the analogy break?|How can it be tested?
output_pattern: function -> biological analogues -> principles -> adapted concepts

description: Use direct personal symbolic and fantasy analogies to make the familiar strange and the strange familiar
best_for: Groups needing a fresh shared perspective on a stubborn problem
facilitation_prompts: What is this like?|How would you experience it personally?|What symbol or fantasy captures it?|What property of the analogy transfers?|What new option follows?
output_pattern: problem -> analogies -> transferred properties -> ideas

description: Compare options against explicit weighted criteria and inspect sensitivity to subjective scores
best_for: Multi-criteria choices where trade-offs should be visible
facilitation_prompts: What are the viable options?|Which criteria reflect the decision?|How were weights chosen?|What evidence supports each score?|Does the winner change under plausible weights?
output_pattern: options x criteria -> weighted comparison -> sensitivity -> recommendation

description: Compare material costs benefits timing and uncertainty without hiding qualitative effects
best_for: Investment choices with meaningful economic consequences
facilitation_prompts: What costs and benefits occur?|To whom?|When?|What is measurable versus qualitative?|Which assumptions dominate the result?
output_pattern: costs/benefits -> timing and uncertainty -> net case -> caveats

description: Prioritise risks by likelihood and impact while recording the evidence confidence and limitations of ordinal scores
best_for: Choices where downside exposure materially affects the decision
facilitation_prompts: What could happen?|What is the plausible likelihood and impact?|What evidence supports the rating?|Which risks are intolerable regardless of score?|What mitigations change exposure?
output_pattern: risks -> likelihood/impact/confidence -> priorities -> mitigations

description: Design a bounded experiment that can distinguish success failure and inconclusive evidence
best_for: High-uncertainty or costly-to-reverse solutions
facilitation_prompts: What assumption must be tested?|What is the smallest credible pilot?|What comparison or baseline is needed?|What are success stop and inconclusive criteria?|What decision follows each result?
output_pattern: hypothesis -> pilot -> measures -> decision rules

description: Assess technical operational financial legal and delivery feasibility to expose blocking conditions
best_for: Options that may be attractive but difficult to execute
facilitation_prompts: Is it technically possible?|Can operations sustain it?|Is it financially viable?|What legal or policy constraints apply?|Which dependency could block it?
output_pattern: option -> feasibility dimensions -> blockers -> conditions -> verdict

description: Run an intervention as an explicit plan do check act learning loop
best_for: Continuous improvement and uncertain implementation
facilitation_prompts: What is the change hypothesis?|What will we do?|What evidence will we check?|What did we learn?|What will we adopt adapt or abandon?
output_pattern: plan -> do -> check -> act -> next cycle

description: Map the minimum actions dependencies milestones and ownership needed to test an intervention
best_for: Bounded pilots with real sequencing or handoff risks
facilitation_prompts: What must happen first?|Where are the handoffs?|Who owns each action?|Which dependency could prevent the test?|What is the first review point?
output_pattern: actions -> dependencies -> ownership -> review point

description: Map affected parties by interest influence impact and stance then plan proportionate involvement
best_for: Changes spanning teams customers partners or decision-makers
facilitation_prompts: Who is affected?|Who can enable or block the change?|What do they need or fear?|Whose voice is missing?|What engagement is appropriate?
output_pattern: stakeholders -> interests/influence/impact -> engagement plan

description: Plan the human transition from current to desired behaviour including communication support and reinforcement
best_for: Organisational change requiring sustained adoption
facilitation_prompts: What behaviour changes?|Who experiences loss or friction?|What resistance is rational?|What communication training or support is needed?|How will the new behaviour be reinforced?
output_pattern: change impacts -> resistance -> support -> reinforcement

description: Define a small set of leading outcome and guardrail measures with owners and action thresholds
best_for: Ongoing interventions needing visible feedback
facilitation_prompts: What outcome proves improvement?|What leading indicators predict it?|What guardrails catch harm?|What baseline target and threshold apply?|Who reviews and acts?
output_pattern: measures -> baselines/targets -> thresholds -> review action

description: Surface high-impact assumptions and explore what changes if each is false removed or inverted
best_for: Solution spaces constrained by inherited beliefs
facilitation_prompts: What are we assuming?|How confident are we?|What happens if the opposite is true?|Which assumption most limits options?|How can we test it?
output_pattern: assumptions -> confidence/impact -> inversions -> tests and options

description: Use an unrelated stimulus to force new connections then translate promising properties back to the problem
best_for: Creative blocks where playful divergence is acceptable
facilitation_prompts: What random word or object will we use?|What properties and associations arise?|How could each map to the problem?|Which connection contains a usable principle?
output_pattern: random stimulus -> associations -> mappings -> ideas

description: Ask how to cause or worsen the problem then reverse controllable causes into safeguards or interventions
best_for: Groups stuck in socially desirable or obvious answers
facilitation_prompts: How could we guarantee failure?|How could we make the problem worse?|Which of these behaviours already occur?|What is the practical reverse?|Which reversals address a supported cause?
output_pattern: failure generation -> existing contributors -> reversals -> interventions

description: Separate facts feelings cautions benefits creativity and process so each receives deliberate attention
best_for: Group decisions where modes of thinking are colliding
facilitation_prompts: What facts do we have?|What is the felt response?|What could fail?|What value is possible?|What alternatives exist?|What process decision is next?
output_pattern: facts -> feelings -> cautions -> benefits -> alternatives -> process

description: Apply substitute combine adapt modify put-to-other-use eliminate and reverse lenses to an existing process or solution
best_for: Incremental-to-creative redesign of something concrete
facilitation_prompts: What can be substituted?|Combined?|Adapted?|Modified?|Used differently?|Eliminated?|Reversed?
output_pattern: existing approach -> seven transformations -> candidate changes
